snippet.title: Emblems: Sunless Vow - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Demo available now! ⚔️🔮🪴 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993190/Emblems_Sunless_Vow_Demo/

Can they stop arguing long enough to escape the void?! A Roguelike Visual Novel with QUICK turn-based combat and flexible difficulty. Calculate, power-up, and stack favors to The Heart's content... Or take on a narrative campaign filled with Mystery + Drama + Shenanigans.

Developed by oldflowerGames, a team of two making the games we always wanted to play.

Bluesky 🦋 https://bsky.app/profile/oldflowergames.bsky.social
